question: Does the rat-prior development gain persist on fresh spatial layouts, under sensory noise, and after learning a competing topology?
selection_boundary: All7 source arms/all3 seeds retained; no selecting favorable source checkpoint, new learning rate or target setting after seeing confirmation. Native8–25 known to researchers remain excluded; final fresh generated geometry is separate from real biological measurements.

geometry.starts: Same10 boundary start coordinates from source layout1, forced walkable; source geometry otherwise not reused.
geometry.generation: For each pair, independently sample18 blocked cells per A and B from cells excluding goal and starts; deterministic rejection until all free cells connect to goal, all starts have shortest distance<=30, and symmetric difference of A/B blocked sets>=20. Seed/accepted candidates/geometry hashes stored before policy evaluation; no rejection based on agent success.
geometry.clock: 45 decisions per trial, reward on goal entry; source digital movement/contact semantics unchanged.
geometry.textures: Registered source3 texture rotations; source renderer/camera/fog/bounds/action semantics fixed.

perception.noise: Independent seeded additive Gaussian noise on all144 normalized pooled pixel features, clipped[-1,1], applied before policy AND observer; contact/reward/last-action uncorrupted. This models sensory perturbation, not a measured species retina.
perception.observer: Common frozen400-view source atlas/sigma.03, source known room/allocentric motion/contact priors. NEW numerically safe log-domain Bayes arithmetic, mathematically matched to source filter on clean technical streams; no target calibration or oracle positions. All controller inputs252 dims.
perception.why: Peer audit found source MAP positions exact100%; do not claim uncertain localisation or memory necessity from old single-view MLP scores. Confirmation reports empirical MAP accuracy/true-cell posterior per phase/tier, plus full-scaffold cost.

phases.A_before: 30 frozen-policy probe trials:10 starts x3 rotations, no weight updates.
phases.B_frozen: 8192 physical decisions on topologyB with source weights frozen; repeat the start/rotation bank until charged decision budget ends.
phases.B_adapt: Independent source-weight clone, same8192 decision allowance/start order/initial RNG; online parentPPO settings unchanged.
phases.A_after: 30 frozen-policy probes afterB_adapt, same starts/rotations/action RNG/sensor-noise seed asA_before. No A learning occurs in retention probe.
phases.inference: B_adapt minusB_frozen measures adaptation utility at matched decision allowance; A_after minusA_before measures retained task performance. A frozenB clone must yield identical A probes under reset state/RNG. Changing topology is a competing navigation setting, not a novel object-category or goal task.

learning.optimizer: Carry each source PPO Adam state; clone independently for frozen/adaptive phases.
learning.recurrent_state: FF controllers have none; frozen belief resets on episode starts. Memory updating and weight updating are distinguished.

denominators: 7arms x3modelseeds x8freshpairs x2sensor tiers; same scenario banks and coupled random seeds across arms.
primary_comparisons: rat_bc vs rat_sham and cold_ppo on A_before success and B adaptation gains
rat_bc vs matched rat_expert and strongest human_expert; retain human_bc/human_sham counterexamples
A_after-A_before paired retention difference per modelseed and freshpair; do not equate nonsignificance with no forgetting
metrics: Exact success counts/30 for A probes
Cumulative completed goals per8192B decisions plus per-episode success, forced-budget truncations and actual episode inventory
B adaptation improvement vs frozen with same decision allowance
Belief MAP/true-cell probability and contact/loop statistics
Actual visual frames, training updates, model/optimizer/observer/buffer state and operation estimates; no energy claim
uncertainty: Report seed effects and scenario effects as crossed dependence; shared source dataset and only3trainingseeds limit inference. Biological subjects do not become336 independent animals.
conventional_reference: Source-reward-learned goal/contact planner with identical common observer evaluated as a separately scoped symbolic-control reference; no hidden target map/pose/goal given. Protocol hashes/models/instances specified before its scientific launch.
numerical_policy: Log-domain observation probabilities remain positive in internal state; implementation/nonfinite observation failures invalidate study, not learner failure. No retries or scenario deletion after evaluation.

cost_resources.GPU: GPU0, two workers maximum, desktop3GiBheadroom preserved; no GUI/Unity

completion_gate: All336 cases terminal and independent geometry/causal sensory/budgets/checkpoint/weights/sampling/replay audits before scores. Go requires technical preflight and geometry manifest hash binding.
claims_boundary: No measured neural mechanism, cross-species homology, clinical utility, physical deployment, universally backprop-free learner, energy advantage or absence of catastrophic forgetting is presumed.
